name: Satou Honoka
source:
[url=/c166985]Hibana[/url]'s carefree mother. She has a very similar personality to her daughter, and enjoys it when people mistake her for Hibana's older sister instead of her actual mother. As such, she wants the others to call her onee-chan and grumbles at or ignores those who call her "mama".

[From [url=https://asa-pro.com/ousama/character/]official website[/url]]
